decision.action: Reject and remove the paired-scale kernel specialization, wrapper option, runtime mode, test parameter, and benchmark mode.
decision.reason: The aggregate median is noise at +0.023%, while the traced Q6 family is 0.038% slower with unchanged resources; scale metadata loads are not the limiter.
decision.production: unchanged at the clean 526.451 tok/s selector-unset baseline
decision.next: Keep Q6 rows64/local128/K32 and attack the twelve scattered packed-quant loads per work item with a byte-neutral contiguous resident micro-layout.
